questions.question: Which of the following rivers is considered the holiest river, in Hinduism?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Ganges) है।

questions.question: The Indian federal structure is inspired by which of the following countries model?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Canada) है।

questions.question: The Rampa Rebellion (1922–24) led by Alluri Sitarama Raju was primarily a protest against:
options: the excessive land revenue assessment in tribal regions by the colonial government
the introduction of compulsory military recruitment during the First World War
the denial of political representation to Indians under the Montagu–Chelmsford Reforms
the restrictions imposed on tribal livelihoods by the Madras Forest Act of 1882
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (the restrictions imposed on tribal livelihoods by the Madras Forest Act of 1882) है।

questions.question: In which of the following food items is tartaric acid present?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Tamarind) है।

questions.question: In July 2025, the Junior Boys’ National Football Championship (Dr. BC Roy Trophy) for the 2025–26 season began in which Indian state?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Punjab) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the main function of the Public  Accounts Committee of Parliament?
options: To appoint on higher posts of public sector units
To examine the policy  according to financial provision
To examine the financial  account of the government and report of Comptroller and  Auditor General
The Speaker of the Vidhan Sabha certifies that the legislation is necessary
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (To examine the financial  account of the government and report of Comptroller and  Auditor General) है।

questions.question: According to a Pali text ‘Matanga Jataka’, the Bodhisatta is identified as a _______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (chandala) है।

questions.question: In December 2000, the Government of India formulated a dedicated scheme for the construction and improvement of roads in rural areas. What is the name of this scheme?
options: North East Special Infrastructure Development Scheme
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana) है।

questions.question: In 2025, an 800-year-old Shiva temple belonging to the later Pandya period (1216–1345) was discovered in:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Tamil Nadu) है।

questions.question: In May 2025, which ministry released India’s draft Climate Finance Taxonomy for consultation?
options: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Ministry of Finance) है।

questions.question: ‘Tavasya,’ launched in 2025, is what type of naval ship?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Stealth Frigate) है।

questions.question: The famous jewelled throne, popularly known as Peacock Throne, was commissioned by which of the following Mughal emperors?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Shah Jahan) है।

questions.question: Where does the term ‘federal’ appear in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Not used anywhere) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding drainage patterns in India is/are correct?I. The drainage pattern that resembles the branches of a tree is known as the dendritic pattern, and it is commonly found in the rivers of the northern plains.II. When rivers originate from a hill and flow outward in all directions, the drainage pattern is termed radial, as seen in rivers originating from the Amarkantak range.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Both I and II) है।

questions.question: The formation of deep gorges and V-shaped valleys by major Himalayan rivers is a result of which geological process?
options: Rapid lateral erosion caused by meandering in the middle course of the rivers
Simultaneous uplift of the Himalayas and intense fluvial erosion by fast-flowing rivers
Volcanic activity followed by sediment compaction in the river basins
Gradual deposition of sediments and subsidence of the surrounding plains
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Simultaneous uplift of the Himalayas and intense fluvial erosion by fast-flowing rivers) है।

questions.question: Economies of scale mean increasing production with _______ per unit.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (decrease in average cost) है।

questions.question: Which specific Veda encompasses guidelines for the execution of sacrificial ceremonies among the ancient Hindu scriptures?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Yajurveda) है।

questions.question: Match the following religions and their respective founders.Religions                           FoundersA. Sikhism                        (i) Rishabhadev B. Buddhism                    (ii) Guru Nanak DevC. Islam                           (iii) Gautam BuddhaD. Jainism                        (iv) Muhammad
options: A – ii, B – iii, C – iv, D – i
A – i, B – iii, C – iv, D – ii
A – i, B – iv, C – iii, D – ii
A – ii, B – iii, C – i, D – iv
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (A – ii, B – iii, C – iv, D – i) है।

questions.question: Mendel’s experiments with one contrasting trait (e.g., tall vs dwarf) are known as _______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (monohybrid crosses) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a survey conducted by the National Statistics Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) to estimate key employment and unemployment indicators in India?
options: RBI data survey of the Indian Economy
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Periodic Labour Force Survey) है।
